title: Task 7 (Multi-Agent Collaboration)
summary: This lesson covers building a multi-agent AI system where multiple agents collaborate to generate a structured report from a user question. You will learn to create a system with at least four specific agent roles working step by step.

sections.text: Step 1. In this task, you will build a multi-agent AI system where multiple agents collaborate to generate a structured report from a user question. Instead of using one LLM, you must create multiple agents, where each agent has a specific role. The agents must work together to complete the task step by step. Done.

Step 2. You must build a system with at least 4 agents: Planner Agent, Research Agent, Writer Agent, Summary Agent, and an optional Evaluator Agent. The system should take a user question and generate a final report using collaboration between agents. Done.
